paragraphs.text: King Suleiman was an ancient king of Rabiah before the Thousandfold Refraction , esteemed for his wisdom and the many Djinni and Efreeti he had imprisoned.

As referenced by the card's flavor text, Suleiman is based on the biblical king Solomon . In One Thousand and One Nights , Solomon sealed a djinni in a bottle, which is referenced in his ability and associated cards. The spelling of his name may be a reference to the Islamic pronunciation of the character's name , or to the longest-reigning sultan of the Ottoman Empire , Suleiman the Magnificent , who is also referenced on the Universes Beyond card Royal Assassin ( Assassin's Creed , #306 ).
